name: Euclidier
_comment: MIDI generator with host-side glue (docs/PORTING.md classification 0): vst.json/params.json only feed tools/gen_vst.py for params.h + the skin (params.json, layout.conf and images/ come from make_skin.py, upstream's design). The plugin is euclidier_vst.cpp, built by this port's own build.sh: the engine (../src) is compiled in-process against rtmidi_stub/RtMidi.h, and notes go out through the plugin's own ALSA seq port 'Euclidier' -- no child process, no engine binary to ship.
